desc: Bowser's stage (kpa_03, story 216): the HUD's score and time (#43). Each digit is drawn with its own icon (before: the digit icons were read in swapped pairs on PC, 180 shown as 091 and a zero score as 111111), the clock counts 1 s for each second of game time, a coin adds to the score; a HUD capture at the start and after the coin
log_must: ^\[kpa\] HUD: score \d+ as icons [\d ]+, time 170 as icons (483|475) (495|487) (481|473); counted 9 s in (89[5-9]\d|90[0-4]\d) ms$
